lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The warehouse squats like a gutted beast by the Delaware River. Jackie and Vito drop Sal 'The Rat' Marino's body into the truck[cite: 3].

lines.speaker: JACKIE
lines.text: You ever think... maybe we're the rats?

choices.text: No. We do what we have to.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Crack. Gunfire splits the night. Vito's chest explodes. Masked men attack[cite: 4].
